text_block_list.name: Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
—You wanna become a GⅠ horse girl~? No way 
in hell, don't make me laugh!

text_block_list.name: Underclassman A
text_block_list.text:
...I-It's not impossible! I'm training 
right now, after all!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Shoving your 'hard work' in 
everyone's faces is an eyesore! Just quit 
already, it's totally pointless!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted a delinquent horse girl 
picking on some earnest horse girls!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: HEY, YOU LOT!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Quit messin' with kids who're givin' it 
their all! Stop hasslin' 'em an' scram 
already!!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
!? ...Tch, what's your deal? Yeah, yeah, 
I'm outta here.

text_block_list.name: Underclassman B
text_block_list.text:
...Th-That was so scary~!! Thank you, 
Tamamo-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Somethin' like that's a piece o' 
cake! If anything else happens, just 
holler at me~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh! Fancy meetin' you two again!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait—what's this, puttin' up posters? Want 
me to give ya a hand?

text_block_list.name: Underclassman A
text_block_list.text: Ah... Tamamo-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Like I said, try wipin' the window glass 
with newspaper! It'll get squeaky clean!

text_block_list.name: Underclassman B
text_block_list.text:
Wah, you're right! Thank you as always, 
Tamamo-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Underclassman B
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! Tamamo-senpa~i! Won't you come have 
lunch over here with us~?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh! Don't mind if I do, then~.

text_block_list.name: Underclassman A
text_block_list.text:
So-any-way! We were thinking of 
challenging ourselves with some new 
training menus~!

text_block_list.name: Underclassman B
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Tamamo-senpai, tell us all 
about your training, please!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hm, mine?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah—... about that... dunno if that's a 
good idea. It's pretty brutally tough, ya 
know?

text_block_list.name: Underclassman A
text_block_list.text:
We'll be fine! That kind of intensity 
makes for much better reference anyway!

text_block_list.name: Underclassman B
text_block_list.text: We'll definitely keep up, just you watch!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hnnn... well, alright then... Wanna give 
it a shot for just tomorrow and see how it 
goes?

text_block_list.name: Underclassman B
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yay~!! We're gonna give it everything 
we've got!!

text_block_list.name: All Underclassmen
text_block_list.text:
"—Huh? Senpai... starting this early!?" 
"It's so early that there's nobody else 
around..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haha, pretty great, right? Just us on this 
huge track... Now this is how you get 
focused first thing in the mornin'!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Haaaaaaah! You can't be takin' ten whole 
seconds for somethin' like this!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Final stretch! Put your soul into them 
legs!! One-two, one-two!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Early one morning. When I went out to the 
academy's track... Tamamo Cross and her 
juniors were training with incredible 
intensity!

text_block_list.name: Underclassman A
text_block_list.text: ...*huff*, *pant*... *gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Alright! Well, that oughta do it for the 
mornin'! We'll pick it back up after 
school—

text_block_list.name: All Underclassmen
text_block_list.text:
"We're so sorry! We can't keep up 
anymore!" "We took this too lightly... 
forgive usss!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Well, kinda had a hunch it'd end 
up like this.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Even so! I ain't cuttin' corners on 
trainin'! The "White Lightning's" motto is 
givin' it your all!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Now, now, ufufu~

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
In that case... how about you and I train 
together this afternoon, Tama-chan~?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Course, Creek! —Alright! Time to get 
fired up!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're gonna do even more from here...!? 
Ta... Tama-senpai's running... is way past 
the level of just lookin' cool...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Over at the edge of the track where the 
two were talking, the delinquent Horse 
Girl from before stood watching with an 
astonished look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Then, since you worked so hard, 
Tama-chan... I'll make sure to give you 
lotsss of gentle headpats~♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa there! Keep your headpats to 
yourself! You try pullin' that every time 
I let my guard down, I swear.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
T-That was insane...! Ta... Tama-senpai's 
running... is way past the level of just 
lookin' cool...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Over at the edge of the track where the 
two were talking, the delinquent Horse 
Girl from before stood watching with an 
astonished look on her face.
